0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-3, 9th in the East, 0.5 games back in fourth place in the Southeast) host the Washington Wizards (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in the Magic's seventh game of the season, with Orlando riding a one-game winning streak and sitting at 0-2 at home. Orlando will be without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met yet this season, but Orlando won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-131 win over Washington in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
